thread:
kelly: Quick sprint — need a tight iteration for website hero + launch posts tied to the webinar funnel. Focus: Hosted API, Dedicated, Private. Two CTAs: webinar sign-up (top-funnel) and demo request (sales). Who can mock 3 hero variants by EOD?
ajay: I can do two variants. Idea A = cost-first ('Reduce unit cost, predictable latency'), Idea B = reliability-first ('Production SLAs, global routing').
maria: I9ll draft microcopy for each mode, 12-15 words each: Hosted (fast time-to-value), Dedicated (reserved throughput + burst), Private (VPC/on-prem, KMS/HSM).
sam: Quick guardrail — avoid specific % claims in hero. Use 'reduce unit cost' and reserve the 3x stat for benchmark and webinar. Also confirm Dedicated mentions "burst capacity".
kelly: Agreed. Ajay, stash the 3x stat for webinar headline and launch post.
ajay: Got it. Routing: webinar CTA -> /signup?source=web_hero&variant=X ; demo CTA -> /demo-request?source=hero. Add UTM params for lead scoring.
noah: Inbound routing suggestion for Sales ops (webhook payload example):
POST /webhook/lead
{
  "email": "...",
  "source": "web_hero",
  "variant": "hosted|dedicated|private",
  "interest": "webinar|demo",
  "traffic_ts": "..."
}
Also add header X-Route: sales or nurture to auto-split.
maria: For launch posts & webinar narrative: lead with a short benchmark snapshot (3x cost reduction vs baseline), then a product-focused use-case, then CTA to webinar + report. Social posts should be one-line + link.
sam: I will review benchmark wording and methods before we publish. Need same model families and seq lengths, with noise bars visible.
calendar-bot: Webinar scheduled: "Inference Cost & Reliability: Benchmarks & Best Practices" — Wed 11/10 10:00 PT. RSVP: https://cal.example.com/r/ri-webinar-1110
ajay: Website experiment plan: headline (cost vs reliability) x CTA (webinar vs demo). 50/50 split for 2 weeks. Pick winner, then amplify via launch posts.
maria: Deliverables: 6 social snippets (X/LinkedIn/email subjects), 3 microcopy blurbs, one long landing paragraph for webinar page.
noah: Lead routing rule example for ops: if interest == demo -> owner = SDR-inbound-demo; else -> nurture_sequence = webinar_followup_v1.
kelly: Perfect. EOD responsabilites: ajay (hero mockups), maria (microcopy + socials), sam (benchmark sign-off), noah (webhook & routing). I9ll compile and drop Figma link. https://www.figma.com/file/placeholder
ajay: Posting variants shortly. :rocket:
